reported.title: Missing debounce handling
reported.description: The sketch does not properly debounce the start button, allowing for multiple bursts to be triggered if the button is pressed and released quickly due to contact bounce.

reported.title: Incorrect settle time
reported.description: The settle time is set to 20 ms, which is insufficient for the specified contact bounce of up to 12 ms, potentially allowing multiple bursts to be triggered.

judge_input.spec:
- Zone valve relay on D10; start button on D6 with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- A settled press on D6 opens the valve (D10 HIGH) for 500 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- Contact bounce up to 12 ms on press and release must not start a second burst.
- Presses while the valve is open are ignored and do not extend it.
- The valve stays closed (D10 LOW) whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `zone n=<count>` every 1000 ms.
